blocks.zh: Section 1: Cleaning Process Design & Development | 清潔製程設計與開發
blocks.en: Section 1: Cleaning Process Design & Development

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives  |  學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the critical process parameters (CPPs) and quality attributes (CQAs) that govern cleaning process design — 掌握清潔製程設計的關鍵製程參數與品質屬性
blocks.en: Understand the critical process parameters (CPPs) and quality attributes (CQAs) that govern cleaning process design

blocks.zh: Distinguish CIP vs. COP systems and their applicable scenarios — 區分就地清洗與移出清洗的適用場景
blocks.en: Distinguish CIP vs. COP systems and their applicable scenarios

blocks.zh: Apply the TACT framework (Time, Action, Concentration, Temperature) to cleaning process optimization — 運用 TACT 框架優化清潔製程
blocks.en: Apply the TACT framework (Time, Action, Concentration, Temperature) to cleaning process optimization

blocks.zh: Understand how Design Space applies to cleaning process development — 理解設計空間概念在清潔開發中的應用
blocks.en: Understand how Design Space applies to cleaning process development

blocks.zh: Explain SOP requirements and operator training criteria for robust cleaning processes — 說明 SOP 要求與操作員訓練標準
blocks.en: Explain SOP requirements and operator training criteria for robust cleaning processes

blocks.zh: Evaluate new product introduction strategies within a validated cleaning system — 評估新產品導入已驗證清潔系統的策略
blocks.en: Evaluate new product introduction strategies within a validated cleaning system

blocks.zh: 中文解析  |  Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 清潔製程設計的核心目的
blocks.en: The core purpose of cleaning process design

blocks.zh: 清潔製程設計與開發（Cleaning Process Design and Development）是清潔驗證的第一步，目的是在正式驗證前確立科學基礎。
blocks.en: Cleaning Process Design and Development is the first step of cleaning validation; its purpose is to establish the scientific basis before formal validation begins.

blocks.zh: 製藥廠不能直接跳到驗證——必須先設計、開發、實驗，才能知道什麼條件有效。
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical plant cannot jump straight to validation. It must first design, develop and experiment to learn which conditions work.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：廚師設計食譜
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: a chef designing a recipe

blocks.zh: 就像廚師不會隨機煮菜，清潔製程也需要「食譜」：哪種清潔劑、多少濃度、接觸幾分鐘、幾度清洗。TACT 就是清潔的「食譜四要素」。
blocks.en: Just as a chef does not cook at random, a cleaning process needs a "recipe": which cleaning agent, at what concentration, for how many minutes, at what temperature. TACT is the "four ingredients" of that cleaning recipe.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語速覽
blocks.en: Key terms at a glance

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）：ICH Q8 概念，輸入變數的多維組合，任何在此範圍內操作均保證品質
blocks.en: Design Space: an ICH Q8 concept; a multidimensional combination of input variables within which operation is assured to deliver quality

blocks.zh: 污染物（Soil）：殘留在設備上需被清除的物質，包含產品殘留、輔料、微生物等
blocks.en: Soil: material left on equipment that must be removed, including product residues, excipients and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 縮小規模實驗（Scale-down experiments）：實驗室模擬生產規模清潔條件，以建立操作範圍
blocks.en: Scale-down experiments: laboratory experiments that simulate production-scale cleaning conditions in order to establish operating ranges

blocks.zh: CPP vs. CQA 的區別
blocks.en: CPP vs. CQA

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）是操作員可以控制的輸入變數，例如清洗溫度、時間、清潔劑濃度。
blocks.en: CPPs (critical process parameters) are input variables the operator can control, such as wash temperature, time and cleaning agent concentration.

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）是清潔結果的輸出指標，例如殘留量、導電度、視覺檢查。
blocks.en: CQAs (critical quality attributes) are output indicators of the cleaning result, such as residue level, conductivity and visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 兩者的關係：控制好 CPP → 確保 CQA 達標。
blocks.en: The relationship between the two: control the CPPs well and the CQAs will be met.

blocks.zh: 清潔頻譜的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical meaning of the cleaning spectrum

blocks.zh: 清潔頻譜（Cleaning Spectrum）是一個風險分類工具：
blocks.en: The Cleaning Spectrum is a risk classification tool:

blocks.zh: 非專用設備（Non-dedicated）比專用設備需要更嚴格的清潔驗證
blocks.en: Non-dedicated equipment requires more rigorous cleaning validation than dedicated equipment

blocks.zh: 固體劑型比液體劑型更難清洗（粉末殘留更難移除）
blocks.en: Solid dosage forms are harder to clean than liquid dosage forms (powder residues are harder to remove)

blocks.zh: 多產品廠（Multiple Product Facility）交叉污染風險最高
blocks.en: Multiple product facilities carry the highest cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: 實務上，稽查員會根據此頻譜評估工廠的清潔風險控制是否合理。
blocks.en: In practice, inspectors use this spectrum to judge whether a plant's cleaning risk controls are reasonable.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院手術室 vs. 一般病房
blocks.en: Analogy: operating theater vs. general ward

blocks.zh: 手術室（高風險）比一般病房（低風險）需要更嚴格的清潔程序。清潔頻譜的邏輯相同：越靠近「高風險端」，清潔要求越嚴格、驗證越完整。
blocks.en: An operating theater (high risk) needs stricter cleaning procedures than a general ward (low risk). The cleaning spectrum follows the same logic: the closer to the "high-risk end", the stricter the cleaning requirements and the more complete the validation.

blocks.zh: T — Time (時間): Length of time for the cycle step. Measured directly (cycle timer) or indirectly (volume at a known flow rate).
blocks.en: T — Time: Length of time for the cycle step. Measured directly (cycle timer) or indirectly (volume at a known flow rate).

blocks.zh: A — Action (機械作用): Mechanism to deliver the cleaning agent — soak, scrubbing, impingement or turbulent flow. Agitation enhances chemical action and shortens contact time.
blocks.en: A — Action: Mechanism to deliver the cleaning agent — soak, scrubbing, impingement or turbulent flow. Agitation enhances chemical action and shortens contact time.

blocks.zh: C — Concentration (濃度): Cleaning agent concentration directly affects performance. Too low = soil not removed; too high = difficulty removing cleaning agent residues.
blocks.en: C — Concentration: Cleaning agent concentration directly affects performance. Too low = soil not removed; too high = difficulty removing cleaning agent residues.

blocks.zh: T — Temperature (溫度): Optimal ranges vary by cleaning step. Initial rinses at ambient; wash solutions heated; final rinse at high temperature to increase solubility and drying rate.
blocks.en: T — Temperature: Optimal ranges vary by cleaning step. Initial rinses at ambient; wash solutions heated; final rinse at high temperature to increase solubility and drying rate.

blocks.zh: TACT 框架詳解 — 時間/機械/濃度/溫度
blocks.en: The TACT framework in detail: time / mechanical action / concentration / temperature

blocks.zh: TACT 是清潔製程的四大可調變數，四者相互影響：
blocks.en: TACT comprises the four adjustable variables of a cleaning process, and the four influence one another:

blocks.zh: 時間（T）：延長接觸時間可補償低溫或低濃度的不足
blocks.en: Time (T): a longer contact time can compensate for low temperature or low concentration

blocks.zh: 機械作用（A）：噴球旋轉、湍流沖刷可替代部分化學作用
blocks.en: Action (A): spray ball rotation and turbulent flow can replace part of the chemical action

blocks.zh: 濃度（C）：必須在最低有效濃度與殘留難以去除的上限之間取得平衡
blocks.en: Concentration (C): must be balanced between the minimum effective concentration and the upper limit above which residues become difficult to remove

blocks.zh: 溫度（T）：升溫可提高清潔效率，但過高可能使蛋白質變性固化（更難移除）
blocks.en: Temperature (T): higher temperature improves cleaning efficiency, but excessive heat can denature and fix proteins (making them harder to remove)

blocks.zh: TACT 互補示意
blocks.en: TACT trade-offs

blocks.zh:
清潔效果 ≈ f(T × A × C × T)

若溫度不足 → 可增加時間或濃度補償
若設備無法高速噴射 → 需延長接觸時間
若清潔劑濃度受限 → 升溫或延時
blocks.en:
Cleaning effectiveness ≈ f(T × A × C × T)

If temperature is insufficient → increase time or concentration to compensate
If the equipment cannot deliver high-velocity spray → extend contact time
If cleaning agent concentration is limited → raise temperature or extend time

blocks.zh: 清洗步驟設計要點
blocks.en: Key points in designing the wash steps

blocks.zh: 預沖洗（Pre-Rinse）：降低後續清洗步驟的污染負荷，是提高清洗效率的關鍵
blocks.en: Pre-Rinse: reduces the soil load for the subsequent wash steps and is key to improving cleaning efficiency

blocks.zh: 最終沖洗（Final Rinse）：水質等級應與產品用水一致——注射劑用 WFI，口服產品用純化水
blocks.en: Final Rinse: the water grade should match the water used in the product: WFI for injectables, purified water for oral products

blocks.zh: 乾燥步驟：防止殘留水分成為微生物生長的條件
blocks.en: Drying step: prevents residual moisture from becoming a condition for microbial growth

blocks.zh: 比喻：TACT 就像洗碗機設定
blocks.en: Analogy: TACT is like dishwasher settings

blocks.zh: 洗碗機有水溫（T）、轉速/噴水壓（A）、洗碗精用量（C）、洗滌時間（T）。油膩餐具需要較高的任一或多個參數組合。製藥清潔製程的邏輯完全相同，只是對「乾淨」的要求遠比洗碗高出幾個數量級。
blocks.en: A dishwasher has water temperature (T), spray speed/pressure (A), amount of detergent (C) and wash time (T). Greasy dishes need a higher setting of one or more of these parameters. The logic of a pharmaceutical cleaning process is exactly the same, except that the requirement for "clean" is several orders of magnitude stricter than for washing dishes.

blocks.zh: 死角（Dead Leg）問題
blocks.en: The dead leg problem

blocks.zh: CIP 系統最常見的驗證失敗原因之一是死角——管路中流速不足的區域，清潔液無法有效沖刷。
blocks.en: One of the most common reasons for CIP system validation failure is dead legs: areas of a pipe with insufficient flow velocity where the cleaning solution cannot flush effectively.

blocks.zh: 解決方法：管路持續向低點傾斜設計、確認所有平行流路均有流量驗證（Proof of Flow）。
blocks.en: Solutions: design piping to slope continuously to a low point, and confirm that all parallel flow paths have flow verification (Proof of Flow).

blocks.zh: 比喻：噴球就像蓮蓬頭
blocks.en: Analogy: a spray ball is like a shower head

blocks.zh: 蓮蓬頭若有死角，水就到不了。製藥槽體的噴球覆蓋測試（riboflavin spray pattern test）就是確認「每個角落都有被清洗液碰到」。
blocks.en: If a shower head has a dead spot, the water cannot reach it. The spray coverage test for tanks (riboflavin spray pattern test) confirms that "every corner is reached by the cleaning solution".

blocks.zh: 污染物（Soil）分類與清除機制
blocks.en: Soil classification and removal mechanisms

blocks.zh: 物理機制：高壓噴射、湍流、刷洗——適合表面附著力低的殘留
blocks.en: Physical mechanisms: high-pressure spray, turbulence and scrubbing, suitable for residues with low surface adhesion

blocks.zh: 化學機制
blocks.en: Chemical mechanisms

blocks.zh: 溶解（Solubility）
blocks.en: Dissolution (Solubility)

blocks.zh: 乳化（Emulsification）
blocks.en: Emulsification

blocks.zh: 螯合（Chelation）
blocks.en: Chelation

blocks.zh: 氧化（Oxidation）——蛋白質殘留常用次氯酸鈉
blocks.en: Oxidation: sodium hypochlorite is commonly used for protein residues

blocks.zh: 若鹼性洗劑與氧化劑配合使用，要注意腐蝕性——不鏽鋼材質選擇需納入設計考量。
blocks.en: When an alkaline detergent is used together with an oxidizing agent, take care over corrosivity; the choice of stainless steel grade must be considered in the design.

blocks.zh: 高危害 API 的清潔設計要求
blocks.en: Cleaning design requirements for highly hazardous APIs

blocks.zh: 具有以下特性的 API 需要更嚴格的清潔製程設計：
blocks.en: APIs with the following characteristics require a more rigorous cleaning process design:

blocks.zh: 高度致敏性（Allergenic）——如 beta-lactams
blocks.en: Highly allergenic, such as beta-lactams

blocks.zh: 細胞毒性（Cytotoxic）——如癌症用藥
blocks.en: Cytotoxic, such as oncology drugs

blocks.zh: 致突變性（Mutagenic）——需評估是否需要專用設備
blocks.en: Mutagenic: assess whether dedicated equipment is needed

blocks.zh: 注射劑（IV/IM）的交叉污染後果遠比口服藥嚴重，殘留限度（Residue Limits）更嚴格。
blocks.en: The consequences of cross-contamination are far more serious for injectables (IV/IM) than for oral drugs, so Residue Limits are stricter.

blocks.zh: 試驗片（Coupon）研究設計
blocks.en: Coupon study design

blocks.zh: 實驗室階段使用金屬試驗片（Coupon）模擬真實設備表面：
blocks.en: In the laboratory phase, metal coupons are used to simulate real equipment surfaces:

blocks.zh: 材質選用：通常選不鏽鋼（最常見），以「最差情況」表面粗糙度（非電解拋光）為佳
blocks.en: Material selection: stainless steel is usually chosen (the most common), preferably with the "worst case" surface roughness (non-electropolished)

blocks.zh: 污染處理：將目標污染物塗抹於試驗片，固定時間乾燥，模擬實際髒污狀態
blocks.en: Soiling: the target soil is applied to the coupon and dried for a fixed time to simulate actual soiling conditions

blocks.zh: 清洗測試：以實驗室規模複製生產清洗條件（TACT 四參數）
blocks.en: Cleaning test: reproduce the production cleaning conditions (the four TACT parameters) at laboratory scale

blocks.zh: 分析結果：目視、殘留分析（TOC、HPLC 等）
blocks.en: Analysis of results: visual inspection and residue analysis (TOC, HPLC, etc.)

blocks.zh: DOE（實驗設計）在清潔開發的應用
blocks.en: Application of DOE in cleaning development

blocks.zh: Design of Experiments（實驗設計）是一種系統化統計方法，可同時評估多個參數及其交互作用：
blocks.en: Design of Experiments (DOE) is a systematic statistical method that can evaluate multiple parameters and their interactions at the same time:

blocks.zh: 單因子研究（One-factor-at-a-time）：找出顯著影響因素
blocks.en: One-factor-at-a-time studies: identify the significant factors

blocks.zh: DOE 研究：量化主效果（Main effects）與交互作用（Interactions）
blocks.en: DOE studies: quantify main effects and interactions

blocks.zh: 回應曲面分析（Response Surface Analysis）：建立設計空間
blocks.en: Response Surface Analysis: establish the design space

blocks.zh: 例如：溫度與濃度之間的交互作用——在低溫下需要更高濃度才能達到相同清潔效果。
blocks.en: Example: the interaction between temperature and concentration; at low temperature a higher concentration is needed to achieve the same cleaning effect.

blocks.zh: FMEA 在參數選擇中的應用
blocks.en: Application of FMEA in parameter selection

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式與影響分析）幫助決定哪些參數值得深入研究：
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) helps decide which parameters merit further study:

blocks.zh: 嚴重性（Severity）：若此參數失控，殘留會有多危險？
blocks.en: Severity: if this parameter goes out of control, how dangerous would the residue be?

blocks.zh: 發生率（Occurrence）：此參數在生產中偏離的可能性？
blocks.en: Occurrence: how likely is this parameter to deviate in production?

blocks.zh: 可偵測性（Detectability）：偏離能否被及時發現？
blocks.en: Detectability: can the deviation be detected in time?

blocks.zh: RPN（風險優先數）= S × O × D，高 RPN 的參數優先納入 DOE 研究。
blocks.en: RPN (Risk Priority Number) = S × O × D; parameters with a high RPN are given priority in DOE studies.

blocks.zh: 放大生產（Scale-Up）的挑戰
blocks.en: Scale-up challenges

blocks.zh: 實驗室的 TACT 條件不能直接複製到生產設備，主要原因：
blocks.en: Laboratory TACT conditions cannot be copied directly to production equipment, mainly because of:

blocks.zh: 幾何差異：大型槽體的死角分布、噴球覆蓋半徑完全不同
blocks.en: Geometric differences: the distribution of dead spots and the spray ball coverage radius in a large tank are completely different

blocks.zh: 流體力學差異：大管徑需要更高的流速才能達到湍流（Re > 10,000）
blocks.en: Fluid dynamics differences: larger pipe diameters require higher flow velocity to achieve turbulence (Re > 10,000)

blocks.zh: 熱均勻性：大容積設備的溫度梯度比實驗室大
blocks.en: Thermal uniformity: large-volume equipment has greater temperature gradients than laboratory equipment

blocks.zh: 因此放大階段必須重新確認清洗效果，而非假設實驗室結果可直接轉移。
blocks.en: Therefore cleaning effectiveness must be reconfirmed at the scale-up stage rather than assuming laboratory results transfer directly.

blocks.zh: 警示水準 vs. 行動水準
blocks.en: Alert level vs. action level

blocks.zh: 警示水準（Alert Level）：超出時需要調查，但不代表清洗失敗。基於正常操作變異設定。
blocks.en: Alert Level: exceeding it requires investigation but does not mean the cleaning has failed. It is set on the basis of normal operating variation.

blocks.zh: 行動水準（Action Level）：超出時必須採取矯正措施，防止清洗品質惡化。
blocks.en: Action Level: exceeding it requires corrective action to prevent cleaning quality from deteriorating.

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須在已驗證的可接受範圍內設定，且行動水準要比警示水準更嚴格。
blocks.en: Both must be set within the validated acceptable range, and the action level must be tighter than the alert level.

blocks.zh: 髒污保持時間 vs. 清潔保持時間
blocks.en: Dirty hold time vs. clean hold time

blocks.zh: 髒污保持時間（Dirty Hold Time, DHT）：批次生產結束到開始清洗的最長允許時間。若超過，污染物乾燥固化，清洗難度大幅上升。
blocks.en: Dirty Hold Time (DHT): the maximum allowed time from the end of batch production to the start of cleaning. If exceeded, the soil dries and hardens, and cleaning becomes much more difficult.

blocks.zh: 清潔保持時間（Clean Hold Time, CHT）：清洗完成到下次使用的最長允許時間。若超過，已清潔設備可能重新受到微生物污染。
blocks.en: Clean Hold Time (CHT): the maximum allowed time from the completion of cleaning to the next use. If exceeded, the cleaned equipment may be re-contaminated by microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 兩個時間均需在清潔驗證中被研究並有數據支持。
blocks.en: Both times must be studied in cleaning validation and supported by data.

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）應用於清潔製程
blocks.en: Applying Design Space to the cleaning process

blocks.zh: 原本在藥品製造製程中使用的設計空間概念（ICH Q8），同樣可應用於清潔製程：
blocks.en: The design space concept (ICH Q8), originally used for pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, can equally be applied to cleaning processes:

blocks.zh: 製造製程設計空間：保證產品品質的多維參數組合
blocks.en: Manufacturing process design space: the multidimensional combination of parameters that assures product quality

blocks.zh: 清潔製程設計空間：保證清洗效果的多維參數組合（溫度、時間、濃度、流速、DHT 等）
blocks.en: Cleaning process design space: the multidimensional combination of parameters that assures cleaning effectiveness (temperature, time, concentration, flow rate, DHT, etc.)

blocks.zh: 只要操作在設計空間內，清潔效果就有科學保證——無需為每種輕微的參數變化重做驗證。
blocks.en: As long as operation stays within the design space, cleaning effectiveness is scientifically assured, and there is no need to repeat validation for every minor parameter change.

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機飛行包線
blocks.en: Analogy: the aircraft flight envelope

blocks.zh: 飛機有安全飛行的「飛行包線（Flight Envelope）」——在速度、高度、仰角等參數範圍內，飛機可安全飛行。清潔設計空間就是「清洗包線」，在此範圍內任何操作組合都保證清洗有效。
blocks.en: An aircraft has a "Flight Envelope": within the ranges of speed, altitude, pitch angle and other parameters, it can fly safely. The cleaning design space is a "cleaning envelope": any combination of operations within it assures effective cleaning.

blocks.zh: 最差情況（Worst Case）污染物策略
blocks.en: Worst case soil strategy

blocks.zh: 若工廠生產多種產品，設計一個「通用清洗程序」的策略：
blocks.en: If a plant makes multiple products, the strategy for designing a "universal cleaning procedure" is:

blocks.zh: 識別最難清洗的污染物（Worst-Case Soil）
blocks.en: Identify the hardest-to-clean soil (Worst-Case Soil)

blocks.zh: 以此污染物建立清洗設計空間
blocks.en: Establish the cleaning design space using this soil

blocks.zh: 若新產品的污染物比最差情況容易清洗 → 可納入現有清洗程序
blocks.en: If the soil of a new product is easier to clean than the worst case → it can be included in the existing cleaning procedure

blocks.zh: 若新產品更難清洗 → 需重新開發清洗程序並重新驗證
blocks.en: If the new product is harder to clean → the cleaning procedure must be redeveloped and revalidated

blocks.zh: 設計空間的監控策略
blocks.en: Monitoring strategy for the design space

blocks.zh: 設計空間建立後，日常生產需監控的關鍵參數：
blocks.en: Once the design space is established, the key parameters to be monitored in routine production are:

blocks.zh: 流量（Flow Rate）— 確保噴球壓力足夠
blocks.en: Flow Rate: confirm that spray ball pressure is sufficient

blocks.zh: 清潔劑濃度（Concentration）— 電導度確認
blocks.en: Cleaning agent Concentration: confirm by conductivity

blocks.zh: 接觸時間（Contact Time）— PLC 計時記錄
blocks.en: Contact Time: recorded by PLC timer

blocks.zh: 溫度（Temperature）— 感測器實時記錄
blocks.en: Temperature: recorded in real time by sensors

blocks.zh: 髒污保持時間（DHT）— 批次記錄確認
blocks.en: Dirty hold time (DHT): confirmed from the batch record

blocks.zh: 任何偏差都需要評估是否超出設計空間，若超出則啟動 CAPA。
blocks.en: Any deviation must be assessed to determine whether it falls outside the design space; if it does, a CAPA is initiated.

blocks.zh: SOP（標準作業程序）在清潔驗證中的地位
blocks.en: The status of the SOP in cleaning validation

blocks.zh: SOP 是清潔製程設計的「輸出文件」，也是後續驗證的基礎：
blocks.en: The SOP is the "output document" of cleaning process design and the basis for subsequent validation:

blocks.zh: 驗證協議必須按照已核准的 SOP 執行
blocks.en: The validation protocol must be executed in accordance with the approved SOP

blocks.zh: SOP 的任何變更都需要評估是否影響已驗證的清潔製程
blocks.en: Any change to the SOP must be assessed for its impact on the validated cleaning process

blocks.zh: 稽查員審查清潔驗證時，第一份看的文件通常就是 SOP
blocks.en: When inspectors review cleaning validation, the first document they look at is usually the SOP

blocks.zh: 清潔 SOP 必備要素（GMP 要求）
blocks.en: Essential elements of a cleaning SOP (GMP requirements)

blocks.zh: 髒污/清潔保持時間上限：必須明確規定（如：使用後 24 小時內開始清洗）
blocks.en: Upper limit for dirty/clean hold time: must be clearly specified (for example, start cleaning within 24 hours after use)

blocks.zh: 設備拆解步驟：詳細到每個零件的拆除順序，確保重現性
blocks.en: Equipment disassembly steps: detailed down to the removal sequence of each part, to ensure reproducibility

blocks.zh: 高風險區域特別標注：如填充針、攪拌器下方——需要特別清潔步驟
blocks.en: Special marking of high-risk areas: such as filling needles and the underside of agitators, which need special cleaning steps

blocks.zh: 取樣測試要求：哪些位置取樣、用什麼方法、判定標準是什麼
blocks.en: Sampling and testing requirements: which locations are sampled, by what method, and what the acceptance criteria are

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬：誰負責執行、誰負責確認、誰負責簽核
blocks.en: Assignment of responsibility: who performs, who verifies and who signs off

blocks.zh: 比喻：SOP 就是清潔的「操作手冊」
blocks.en: Analogy: the SOP is the cleaning "operating manual"

blocks.zh: 就像飛機的起降清單（Checklist），每一步都要照順序執行並記錄。在製藥廠，清潔 SOP 的重要性不亞於生產 SOP——因為清潔失敗直接影響下一批產品的安全性。
blocks.en: Like an aircraft take-off and landing checklist, every step must be performed in order and recorded. In a pharmaceutical plant, the cleaning SOP is just as important as the production SOP, because a cleaning failure directly affects the safety of the next batch.

blocks.zh: 操作員訓練的三階段模型
blocks.en: The three-stage model of operator training

blocks.zh: TR29 描述的訓練三步驟與現代技能培訓框架一致：
blocks.en: The three training steps described in TR29 are consistent with modern skills training frameworks:

blocks.zh: 知識（Know）：閱讀並理解 SOP 內容
blocks.en: Know: read and understand the SOP

blocks.zh: 示範（Show）：由已訓練的操作員示範正確程序
blocks.en: Show: a trained operator demonstrates the correct procedure

blocks.zh: 執行（Do）：受訓者自行操作並被評估
blocks.en: Do: the trainee performs the procedure alone and is assessed

blocks.zh: 手動清洗還需額外步驟：測量受訓者清洗後設備上的殘留量，以客觀數據確認訓練是否有效。
blocks.en: Manual cleaning needs an additional step: measure the residue left on the equipment after the trainee has cleaned it, to confirm with objective data that the training is effective.

blocks.zh: 手動清洗 vs. 自動清洗的訓練頻率
blocks.en: Training frequency for manual vs. automated cleaning

blocks.zh: 手動清洗高度依賴操作員技能，因此需要更頻繁的再訓練（Requalification）：
blocks.en: Manual cleaning depends heavily on operator skill, so more frequent retraining (requalification) is needed:

blocks.zh: 自動化 CIP：PLC 保證一致性，操作員訓練頻率較低
blocks.en: Automated CIP: the PLC ensures consistency, so operator training is less frequent

blocks.zh: 手動清洗：每次換人、長期未執行、SOP 修改後，都需要重新確認能力
blocks.en: Manual cleaning: competence must be reconfirmed whenever the operator changes, after a long period without performing the task, and after an SOP revision

blocks.zh: FDA 483 觀察中，「操作員訓練不足」是清潔驗證領域最常見的缺失之一。
blocks.en: In FDA 483 observations, "inadequate operator training" is one of the most common deficiencies in the cleaning validation area.

blocks.zh: 比喻：外科醫師訓練
blocks.en: Analogy: surgeon training

blocks.zh: 外科手術技能不能只靠讀書學會——需要示範、模擬、實操、考核。手動清洗操作員的訓練邏輯相同：理論知識必須轉化為可重現的操作技能，並有客觀評估標準。
blocks.en: Surgical skills cannot be learned from books alone; they need demonstration, simulation, hands-on practice and assessment. The training logic for manual cleaning operators is the same: theoretical knowledge must be turned into reproducible operating skill, with objective assessment criteria.

blocks.zh: 變更控制（Change Control）的必要性
blocks.en: The need for change control

blocks.zh: 每次新產品引入都需要通過變更控制系統評估：
blocks.en: Every new product introduction must be assessed through the change control system:

blocks.zh: 新活性成分的理化特性（溶解度、毒性、致敏性）
blocks.en: Physicochemical properties of the new active ingredient (solubility, toxicity, allergenicity)

blocks.zh: 與現有最差情況的比較分析
blocks.en: Comparative analysis against the existing worst case

blocks.zh: 是否需要更新清潔驗證主計劃（CVMP）
blocks.en: Whether the Cleaning Validation Master Plan (CVMP) needs to be updated

blocks.zh: 是否需要更新殘留限度計算
blocks.en: Whether the residue limit calculations need to be updated

blocks.zh: 這個系統是「已驗證清洗系統的生命週期管理」核心機制。
blocks.en: This system is the core mechanism for lifecycle management of a validated cleaning system.

blocks.zh: 新產品導入的決策流程
blocks.en: Decision flow for new product introduction

blocks.zh: 新產品引入
blocks.en: New product introduction

blocks.en: Laboratory coupon study

blocks.zh: 比較與現有最差污染物的清洗難度

blocks.zh: Practice Questions  |  思考練習題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Q1. TACT 框架應用
blocks.en: Q1. Applying the TACT framework

blocks.zh: 你的 CIP 清洗程序目前在 60°C 下清洗 15 分鐘，清潔劑濃度 2%。驗證結果顯示在最大 DHT 條件下，某批次的 API 殘留略高於限度。在不更改清潔劑種類的前提下，你應考慮調整哪些 TACT 參數？每種調整有哪些限制？
blocks.en: Your CIP cleaning procedure currently washes for 15 minutes at 60°C with a 2% cleaning agent concentration. Validation results show that, under maximum DHT conditions, API residue in one batch was slightly above the limit. Without changing the type of cleaning agent, which TACT parameters should you consider adjusting? What are the limitations of each adjustment?

blocks.zh: 參考方向：溫度上限（設備耐受性、蛋白質變性風險）、時間延長（生產效率影響）、濃度提高（清潔劑殘留增加風險、成本）、機械作用（噴球流速、壓力提升可能性）。
blocks.en: Suggested direction: temperature ceiling (equipment tolerance, risk of protein denaturation), longer time (impact on production efficiency), higher concentration (greater risk of cleaning agent residue, cost), mechanical action (possibility of increasing spray ball flow rate and pressure).

blocks.zh: Q2. 設計空間應用
blocks.en: Q2. Applying the design space

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前生產 5 種藥品，使用同一套 CIP 系統。已知最難清洗的是藥品 C（蛋白質類 API，高度黏附性）。現在要引入藥品 F，其 API 是一種水溶性小分子。請說明如何利用「設計空間」概念決定是否需要為藥品 F 重新驗證清洗程序？
blocks.en: Your plant currently makes 5 drug products using the same CIP system. The hardest to clean is known to be product C (a protein API with strong adhesion). You now want to introduce product F, whose API is a water-soluble small molecule. Explain how you would use the "design space" concept to decide whether the cleaning procedure needs to be revalidated for product F.

blocks.zh: 參考方向：以藥品 C 的 Worst-Case 條件進行實驗室試驗片研究，比較兩者清洗難度；若藥品 F 更易清洗，現有設計空間即可涵蓋；若更難，需重新建立設計空間並重新驗證。
blocks.en: Suggested direction: run a laboratory coupon study under the worst-case conditions of product C and compare the cleaning difficulty of the two; if product F is easier to clean, the existing design space covers it; if it is harder, the design space must be re-established and the cleaning revalidated.

blocks.zh: Q3. 手動清洗操作員訓練
blocks.en: Q3. Manual cleaning operator training

blocks.zh: 你的廠區某條填充線使用手動清洗（COP）。稽查員指出你的訓練記錄只有「閱讀並確認 SOP」的簽名，沒有操作展示記錄，也沒有殘留測試結果支持訓練有效性。你如何改進訓練系統以符合 PDA TR29 的建議？
blocks.en: A filling line at your site uses manual cleaning (COP). The inspector points out that your training records contain only a signature for "read and acknowledged the SOP", with no record of practical demonstration and no residue test results to support the effectiveness of the training. How would you improve the training system to align with PDA TR29 recommendations?

blocks.zh: 參考方向：增加操作展示（由訓練師示範）、受訓者展示記錄、清洗後以棉棒取樣或 TOC 測試確認清洗效果、建立再訓練觸發條件（SOP 修訂、長期未執行、績效考核不達標）。
blocks.en: Suggested direction: add practical demonstration (by the trainer), trainee demonstration records, swab sampling or TOC testing after cleaning to confirm cleaning effectiveness, and define retraining triggers (SOP revision, long period without performing the task, unsatisfactory performance review).

blocks.zh: Q4. CIP vs. COP 的驗證挑戰
blocks.en: Q4. Validation challenges of CIP vs. COP

blocks.zh: 你的工廠準備為一台新的多功能反應器設計清潔驗證計劃。該反應器主體為 CIP 設計，但攪拌器組件需拆除後進行 COP 清洗。請列出針對 COP 部分你需要額外考量的驗證要素（相較於 CIP 部分）。
blocks.en: Your plant is preparing a cleaning validation plan for a new multi-purpose reactor. The vessel body is designed for CIP, but the agitator assembly must be removed and cleaned by COP. List the additional validation elements you need to consider for the COP portion (compared with the CIP portion).

blocks.zh: 參考方向：拆解 SOP 的重現性、拆解件的識別與追蹤、運輸過程的污染控制、清洗液對各零件的覆蓋驗證、重組後的密封性確認、COP 設備本身的清潔驗證（是否為交叉污染源）。
blocks.en: Suggested direction: reproducibility of the disassembly SOP, identification and tracking of disassembled parts, contamination control during transport, verification of cleaning solution coverage of each part, confirmation of seal integrity after reassembly, and cleaning validation of the COP equipment itself (is it a source of cross-contamination).
